notes: - contradiction: "Orodus fossils have been found in Europe, Asia, and North America dating from the late Devonian to the Late Carboniferous periods. The time range for Orodus spans from the Frasnian to the Wordian, between 382.31 and 264.9 million years ago.": Sentence 6 states that Orodus fossils span from the late Devonian to the Late Carboniferous, yet it also gives a time range from the Frasnian (late Devonian) to the Wordian (middle Permian), which contradicts the earlier period description.
